title: Copilot Credits: the shared meter for usage-based AI billing
summary: Hold: several automation entries are not usable as printed, including the credit-allocation request, which omits the value that enables or disables tenant-pool consumption. The alert and consumption endpoints also cover less than their table rows promise: policy-level alerts and service-level totals, respectively.

claims.claim: Spending policies are added at Microsoft 365 admin center > Copilot > Cost Management > Configuration > Add spending policy.
claims.quote:
In the Microsoft 365 admin center, go to Copilot > Cost Management.
2. Select Configuration, and then select Add spending policy.

claims.claim: The printed POST spendingPolicies call with a body consisting of property names is sufficient to create a spending policy.
claims.quote: Because spendingPolicy is abstract, the request body must set a concrete @odata.type, either #microsoft.graph.allUsersSpendingPolicy or #microsoft.graph.selectedGroupsSpendingPolicy.
claims.fix: Keep POST https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/copilot/costManagement/spendingPolicies and replace the parenthetical with this body, substituting the placeholders: {"@odata.type":"#microsoft.graph.allUsersSpendingPolicy","displayName":"<policy-name>","periodLimit":{"@odata.type":"#microsoft.graph.limitedCostManagementQuantity","value":<policy-credit-limit>,"unit":"copilotCredit"},"perUserLimit":{"@odata.type":"#microsoft.graph.limitedCostManagementQuantity","value":<user-credit-limit>,"unit":"copilotCredit"},"serviceSettings":[{"serviceId":"<service-id>","state":"enabled"}]}. Use Authorization: Bearer <token> and Content-Type: application/json. Qualify this as creation of an all-users policy, initially disabled; preserve the beta warning.

claims.claim: Creating a spending policy requires Billing Administrator or Global Administrator.
claims.quote: At runtime, creating a policy also requires the Billing Administrator or Global Administrator directory role.

claims.claim: AI administrator and License administrator can edit policies, limits and alerts but cannot create policies.
claims.quote: AI administrator and License administrator roles can edit spending policies, manage limits and alerts, and billing methods. However, they can't create spending policies.

claims.claim: A resource-based policy for Copilot Studio environments or agents is created through Copilot > Cost Management > Configuration > Add spending policy > Resources.
claims.quote:
Select Configuration, and then select Add spending policy.
3. Enter a name for the policy, then select Resources as its scope.

claims.claim: No API for creating resource-based spending policies is documented at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft Graph Copilot costManagement resource based spending policy environments agents create API. Opened Cost Management API overview and spendingpolicy-create; their policy types cover all users or selected groups, not resources.

claims.claim: An existing spending policy's billing method is changed by opening the policy under Copilot > Cost Management > Configuration.
claims.quote: You can update the billing method for an existing spending policy. Open the spending policy that you want to modify and update its billing method.

claims.claim: POST spendingPolicies with only an optional billingMethods property is a usable automation equivalent for setting a spending policy's billing method.
claims.quote: Required properties are displayName, periodLimit, perUserLimit, and serviceSettings. You can optionally supply billingMethods.
claims.fix: Restrict the API-side description to 'Select a billing method when creating an all-users policy, initially disabled'. Keep POST https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/copilot/costManagement/spendingPolicies with Authorization: Bearer <token>, Content-Type: application/json and body {"@odata.type":"#microsoft.graph.allUsersSpendingPolicy","displayName":"<policy-name>","periodLimit":{"@odata.type":"#microsoft.graph.limitedCostManagementQuantity","value":<policy-credit-limit>,"unit":"copilotCredit"},"perUserLimit":{"@odata.type":"#microsoft.graph.limitedCostManagementQuantity","value":<user-credit-limit>,"unit":"copilotCredit"},"billingMethods":"prepaidCredits","serviceSettings":[{"serviceId":"<service-id>","state":"enabled"}]}. Label prepaidCredits as the example billing method from the reference, not a way to update an existing policy.

claims.claim: Global administrator or Billing administrator can set or override a spending policy's billing method.
claims.quote: You must be a Global administrator or Billing administrator to override or set the billing method.

claims.claim: The Add spending policy workflow supports policy and per-user alert configuration.
claims.quote:
If the policy has a monthly per-user limit, configure user-level threshold notifications:

- Turn on user notifications for the policy.
- Specify the threshold percentage at which users receive an email.

claims.claim: PATCH emailThresholdSettings configures both policy and per-user spending alerts.
claims.quote: Notify-only alert configuration for a spending policy, addressed as the policy's emailThresholdSettings. Each policy has at most one, retrieved from its own URL beneath the policy.
claims.fix: Narrow the API-side description to 'Policy-level threshold alerts only; this call does not configure per-user notification thresholds'. Keep PATCH https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/copilot/costManagement/spendingPolicies/{id}/emailThresholdSettings with Authorization: Bearer <token>, Content-Type: application/json, If-Match: <parent-policy-ETag> and body {"isEnabled":true,"thresholds":[{"@odata.type":"#microsoft.graph.percentageCostManagementAlertThreshold","value":<threshold-percentage>}]}. State that recipients are managed separately and at least one must already be linked before enabling alerts.

claims.claim: The Graph spending-policy alerts are notify-only.
claims.quote: Create or update the notify-only alert configuration for a spending policy

claims.claim: Environment credit allocation and overage settings are reached through Licensing > Products > Copilot Studio > Summary > Manage Capacity.
claims.quote:
Select Manage Capacity from the Prepaid capacity card.

In the allocation panel, select an environment and specify the number of Copilot Credits to allocate in the Copilot Credits textbox.
claims.fix: Append the omitted environment selection: 'Licensing > Products > Copilot Studio > Summary > Manage Capacity > environment'. Apply the same change to the rendered table.

claims.claim: The printed allocationsV2 PUT, specifying MCSMessages and ruleType TenantPool alone, configures allocation and overage behaviour.
claims.fix: The pre-check's literal-URL miss is not an endpoint error: the tutorial constructs this URL from apiBaseUrl and apiVersion. Keep PUT https://api.powerplatform.com/licensing/allocationsV2?api-version=2024-10-01 with Authorization: Bearer <token> and Content-Type: application/json. Replace the parenthetical with body {"scope":{"environmentId":"<environment-id>"},"allocatedEntitlements":[{"entitlementId":"MCSMessages","allocation":{"quantity":<credit-quantity>},"enforcementRules":[{"ruleType":"TenantPool","enabled":<true-or-false>}]}]}. Explain that enabled=false prevents tenant-pool draw and enabled=true permits it; these settings do not disable a separate pay-as-you-go source.
